text:
Maya (Growth): Quick: publishing webinar landing + 3 posts tomorrow. Need final SEO checklist: keywords, JSON-LD, internal anchors, and simple redirects for /events and /webinars. Lock by 5pm PT.
Owen (SEO): I'll do 2 primary + 1 longtail keywords per piece and mark SERP intent. Will add 3 anchor variants per link.
Priya (Content): Drafts up. Adding 160-char metas and OG images (1200x630). Which pages get FAQ schema?
Jin (Web): Recommend FAQ on recap only. Inject JSON-LD in head for SSR; prerender for SPA. Example event snippet: {"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"Event","name":"Serving LLMs at Scale","url":"https://redwood.ai/webinar/serve-llms"} (paste into head).
seo-bot: Preflight flags: duplicate meta between landing & post1; missing H1 on post2. Re-scan after edits.
Maya (Growth): Redirects: whitelist old slugs, single 301 to new landing, preserve querystring/UTM. Jin please implement.
Jin (Web): Will add rules: return 301 $scheme://$host/webinar/serve-llms?$query_string; and run dry-run. Also queue sitemap entry (priority 0.8) and CDN invalidation for OG.
Owen (SEO): Anchor plan: landing -> /product/inference ("LLM inference platform", "high-throughput inference", "reduce token costs"); benchmark -> /benchmarks; recap -> /resources/webinars.
Priya (Content): I'll mark duplicates in the sheet keep/301 and update slugs + metas by EOD.
Maya (Growth): Owners: Priya (copy & metas), Owen (keywords & anchors), Jin (redirects & JSON-LD), seo-bot (final scan). Ping me for blockers before freeze.
